The value being assigned to `destDirectory` at line 37 is exactly the value of `destFile` at line 36 (before it gets set to null at line 38). So the value of `destFile` at line 37 (which is the value that was assigned to `destDirectory`) does depend on the value of `destFile` at line 36.
